app.name: Family Food Planner
app.description: Plan weekly meals for your family with confidence.
app.footer: Family Food Planner — plan the week, shop once, eat well.

plans.title: Plans
plans.description: Select a weekly plan to edit meals or open its grocery list.
plans.emptyDescription: Once a plan is created it will appear here with its meals and grocery list.

planNew.title: Create a plan
planNew.description: Choose the days your week runs from and to. A day card is created for every date in the range.
planNew.nameHint: Leave blank to let the app name the plan from its date range.
planNew.failedNow: Could not create plan right now.

planSettings.title: Plan settings
planSettings.description: Rename the plan or move its date range. Days are added or removed to match.
planSettings.datesRequired: Both start and end dates are required.

planSettings.deleteDescription: This action cannot be undone. Deleting this food plan will also delete its grocery list.

mealSwap.hintBefore: Need Tuesday's dinner on Monday? Drag a meal's
mealSwap.hintAfter: button onto the same meal of another day, or press it to pick the day from a list. Breakfast, lunch, and dinner each move on their own.

grocery.description: Everything you need to buy for this plan, synced live with anyone holding the share link.
grocery.loadFailed: Could not load grocery list for this plan.

share.title: Share the list
share.description: Share this link so anyone can tick items off while shopping, or open it yourself in a new tab. Rotate it only when you need to invalidate old links.

general.title: Add general item
general.description: Household staples that are not tied to a specific meal.

ingredient.description: Ingredients linked to a meal in this plan, so you know what they are for.
ingredient.noMealsWarning: Add at least one breakfast, lunch, or dinner dish in this plan before creating ingredient items.
ingredient.required: Ingredient name and meal are required.

merged.title: Merged shopping list
merged.description: Duplicate ingredients across meals are combined into a single shopping line. Drag a line by its handle to arrange the list in the order you walk the store.
merged.emptyDescription: Add a general item or a meal ingredient to start your list.
merged.dragHint: Drag the handle to reorder, or focus it and use the arrow keys. The order is shared with everyone using the link.
merged.orderFailed: Could not save the new shopping order.

items.title: Edit or remove items
items.description: Every individual entry, including the meal it came from, listed in the shopping order set above.
items.emptyDescription: Items you add above will show up here.

members.title: Family members
members.description: Manage who is included in your family meal planning. Members can be assigned to breakfast and lunch dishes.

settings.description: Choose how the planner keeps you up to date. These settings apply to your account.
